nodes.answer: The study aims to provide an empirical sketch to legislators that can help resolve environmental issues through green steps at the domestic level.

nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: How does receiving additional information on environmental impacts affect left-leaning respondents differently from centrist respondents?
nodes.answer: Left-leaning respondents are more prone to update their knowledge on environmental impacts of local consumption when receiving additional information compared to centrist respondents.
